IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY: the Discussion separately states 'Based on the mean blood half-life of 25 min, we can rationalize that the majority of cRGD-ZW800-1 is internalized during the first hours', giving a second, unlabelled 25 min blood half-life in the body. The Figure 6 caption states 'Half-life calculated via ln(2)/k10', i.e. the authors performed the conversion themselves and reported a half-life in minutes; no rate constant value is printed. The distribution-phase half-life is referred to only by 'see Supplementary Table 2 for individual results' and no value appears in the body.
